source.author: hor
source.text: Exegi monumentum aere perennius regalique situ pyramidum altius, quod non imber edax, non aquilo impotens possit diruere aut innumerabilis annorum series et fuga temporum.
source.text_original: Exegi monumentum aere perennius / regalique situ pyramidum altius, / quod non imber edax, non aquilo impotens / possit diruere aut innumerabilis / annorum series et fuga temporum.
source.text_english: I have built a monument more lasting than bronze and loftier than the royal structure of the pyramids, which neither devouring rain nor the violent north wind can destroy, nor the countless succession of years and the flight of time.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: exegi monumentum aere perennius, quod nulla destruere possit uetustas.
reuse.text_original: exegi monumentum aere perennius, quod nulla destruere possit uetustas.
reuse.text_english: I have built a monument more lasting than bronze, which no time can destroy.
